verdicts.title: Sign rank versus VC dimension
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
This work studies the maximum possible sign rank of $N \times N$ sign matrices with a given VC dimension $d$. For $d=1$, this maximum is {three}. For $d=2$, this maximum is $\tildeΘ(N^{1/2})$. verdicts.title: Nontrivial bundles of coadjoint orbits over $S^2$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $G$ be a compact connected semisimple Lie group with Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$. Let $\mathcal{O}\subset\mathfrak{g}^*$ be a coadjoint orbit.
